purpose: Test whether standardized constrained relaxation improves retrospective held-out B/NB prediction. Lower structural energy alone is not success.

scope.labels: Binder and weak binding are B; explicit nonbinder is NB. Failed expression and missing measurements are excluded, never NB.

replicates.primary: Median of all three complete, valid dG_separated scores in REU

pilot.selection: Within each antigen, sort by (binder length, condition ID); select indices0,floor((n-1)/2),n-1. No labels, scores, or outcomes enter selection.
pilot.purpose: Technical correctness, runtime and memory only; no setting selection from binding labels or evaluation scores
technical_gates: Exact sequences, chains, residue mapping and heavy atom identities
All chain jumps fixed, persistent constraints active throughout relax, constraints removed before scoring
Raw baseline dG reproduction within 0.0001 REU; discrepancies require technical investigation, never outcome-based exclusion
Recorded runtime version matches original version; all 18 expected replicates valid
Movement and close-contact warnings reviewed without exclusion based on score or label

evaluation.splits: EXACT train/test IDs and family exclusions in original results.json; no reassignment
comparisons: Original vs relaxed single-feature logistic regression
Original four-feature logistic vs only Rosetta replaced by relaxed median
evaluation.standardization: StandardScaler fitted on training rows only

threshold.role: Prespecified diagnostic only; no test-set tuning
threshold.raw_scores: No probability or B/NB threshold assigned

evaluation.aggregation: Within-antigen headline is test-size-weighted mean of all saved folds; exact individual-fold ROC/PR curves shown separately. Pooled curves and metrics descriptive only.
evaluation.failures: Compare both methods on identical rows with all three valid replicates. Filter original train/test membership identically; no imputation or regrouping. Unavailable aggregate if a required fold cannot be evaluated.
evaluation.confidence: Original ipSAE/ipTM/pLDDT/PAE stay associated with original ESMFold2-Fast predictions; relaxation generates no new confidence scores
evaluation.conclusion: Report paired changes by antigen, held-out fold and family, including null/negative results. Cross-antigen tests also change assay and design distributions; no claim of prospective or universal generalization.

execution.concurrency: Pilot conservative max 2 after fresh resource verification; cohort chosen from measured runtime/memory and current limits
execution.full_cost: Estimate only after measured pilot; no guessed cost claimed
